description: German Federal bond (Bund) conventions: annual coupons accruing Actual/Actual (ICMA) on unadjusted periods, coupon dates generated backward from maturity, payment Following, settlement T+2 on the Germany calendar, redemption 100, yield quoted Actual/Actual (ICMA) Compounded Annual. Trade-only preset (fixed_rate_bond); the discount curve comes from the market.
provenance: Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds (Bunds): https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds (annual interest, interest dates and maturities of the Bund family); Actual/Actual (ICMA) day count per ICMA Rule 251 as implemented by QuantLib 1.44 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.44/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp (an ICMA rule-book URL could not be confirmed from the build environment, so the QuantLib header is cited for the day counter)

field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.settlement_days: T+2: Bund trades settle two business days after trade date (market practice stated with the Finanzagentur's Federal securities pages) (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.calendar: Germany: the engine's Calendar enum for German settlement (QuantLib Germany::Settlement) (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.conventi: Unadjusted: coupon periods run calendar date to calendar date; accrual is on the unadjusted dates (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.terminat: Unadjusted: the maturity date is the calendar date (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.date_gen: Backward: coupon dates are generated from the maturity date, a short first period if any (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.schedule.end_of_m: false: coupon dates keep the maturity date's day of month (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.frequency: Annual: Bunds pay interest once a year on the interest date (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.accrual_day_count: Actual/Actual (ICMA): ICMA Rule 251 as used for Bunds; the engine's DayCounter ActualActualISMA = QuantLib 1.44 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.44/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.payment_conventio: Following: a coupon falling on a non-business day is paid on the next business day; accrual itself is Unadjusted (market practice, stated here as such: the cited source https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds fixes the accrual and yield formulae, not the payment-date adjustment)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.redemption: 100: redeemed at par (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.day_counter: Actual/Actual (ICMA): ICMA Rule 251 as used for Bunds; the engine's DayCounter ActualActualISMA = QuantLib 1.44 ActualActual::ISMA, https://github.com/lballabio/QuantLib/blob/v1.44/ql/time/daycounters/actualactual.hpp
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.compounding: Compounded: the quoted yield compounds once per coupon period (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
field_provenance.trades.fixed_rate_bond.yield.frequency: Annual: Bunds pay interest once a year on the interest date; the yield compounds at the coupon frequency (Deutsche Finanzagentur, Federal bonds, https://www.deutsche-finanzagentur.de/en/federal-securities/types-of-federal-securities/federal-bonds)
